sources.quote: HD 52265, also named Citalá, is a star with an orbiting exoplanet companion in the equatorial constellation of Monoceros.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.4 solar radii and 1.13 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,982 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
